summary: The meeting successfully renamed the streaming format from MOQT Streaming Format (MSF) to MOQT Secure Format (MSF) and its CMAF-compliant variant to CMSF, establishing a unified naming convention. Key technical updates included adopting a fragment-based URL scheme for client-side metadata, implementing variable substitution for personalized catalogs, and defining a new encryption mechanism for secure object delivery.
